simple.meaning: עֵין־דֹּאר (ʻÊyn-Dôʼr) is a Hebrew word meaning “En-Dor , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֵין־דֹּאר (H5874) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Joshua 17:11, with occurrences in Joshua, 1 Samuel, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֵין־דֹּאר (H5874) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֵין־דֹּאר (H5874) before moving outward to related references.
